answer: The kernel escrow holds each stake, the sparrow settlement releases it, and the inlet audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 26% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 74 keys hence pays that exposure 74 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
